answer_1.quote: We evaluate the abilities of modern LLMs at the task of faithfully conveying their intrinsic uncertainty.
answer_1.outputs: Generated responses to factual questions, sometimes with hedging expressions to convey uncertainty.

answer_2.quote: We formalize this through the notion of faithful response uncertainty ( §2), an example-level score that quantifies the gap between the (linguistic) decisiveness in which the model conveys its assertions and its intrinsic confidence in them.

answer_3.quote: We implement the above scores (Eq. 1, Eq. 2) by prompting a 'judge' LLM. ... In our experiments, we use Gemini Ultra as the judge.

answer_4.quote: For decisiveness (Eq. 1), ... the distribution of perceived probabilities humans assigned to it (using survey data from Fagen-Ulmschneider ( )). ... For confidence (Eq. 2), we compare the confidence scores ... versus when using labels written by the authors.
answer_4.guideline: Humans assigned perceived probabilities to hedging expressions; authors provided labels for confidence by checking sampled answers.
